scenes.heading: Avoiding scope creep as a virtual assistant

sents.d: Avoiding scope creep as a virtual assistant
Gradual scope expansion is one of the most common profitability problems in this field.
VA scope creep often happens gradually — a client asks for 'one small extra task' repeatedly until the actual workload significantly exceeds the agreed retainer hours, without any adjustment to pay.
Tracking hours by task category, not just total hours, makes it easier to identify when a specific area of work has quietly grown beyond what was originally agreed.

When retainer hours are consistently exceeded, proactively raising it with the client — proposing either an increased retainer or reduced scope — protects your margin better than silently absorbing the extra work indefinitely.

take: Track hours by task and raise overages early.
